name: 335. Gemini API speech and transcription: content blocks, undeliverable fields, the output-token bound, full usage, truncated streams (gemini speech contract) [SERIAL]
description: TXE-6539 regression, contract C3, C4, C5, C6, C10. Local fixture regression, no live provider calls: run with providerErrorFixture=1 against the gateway of tests/e2e/api/provider_config/provider-error-fixture.config.json, with tests/e2e/api/runners/provider-error-fixture.mjs as the only upstream. The gemini provider there points at the fixture's /pp/gemini, which answers the models pp-tts-ok, pp-tts-blocked, pp-tts-truncated and pp-stt-ok in the generateContent shape; no Gemini TTS response has been recorded for these rows. The rows cover every inbound route the change reaches: /v1/audio/speech buffered and streamed, the OpenAI drop-in speech and transcription routes, /v1/audio/transcriptions, and the native GenAI generateContent and streamGenerateContent. Every row names the key with x-bf-api-key and reads back the bytes that reached the fixture from /__wire, so it also pins one upstream call per request (none for a refused request). Before the change a blocked prompt was an empty audio and a 400 with no error_type, speed, instructions, language_code, language and response_format were dropped silently, max_output_tokens was not a field, an empty response_format answered bare PCM, the done frame carried three token counts, and a stream that ended without finishReason ended on speech.audio.done. Run the whole folder in order.

item.name: 335.1 gemini/pp-tts-ok /v1/audio/speech stream_format sse with max_output_tokens: the bound reaches generationConfig.maxOutputTokens and speech.audio.done carries every usage detail, from one upstream call (gemini speech contract)

exec: pm.test('gemini speech contract setup: the fixture was reset', function () {
// geminiCalls: the requests that reached the fixture's Gemini upstream, bytes as they arrived.

function geminiCalls(cb) { pm.sendRequest({ url: FX + '/__wire', method: 'GET' }, function (err, res) { pm.test('the fixture answered /__wire', function () { pm.expect(err, String(err)).to.equal(null); pm.expect(res.code).to.equal(200); }); cb(res.json().data[0].calls.filter(function (c) { return c.path.indexOf('/pp/gemini/models/') === 0; })); }); }

pm.test('the client gets 200 with an SSE stream', function () { pm.expect(pm.response.code, raw).to.equal(200); pm.expect(pm.response.headers.get('content-type') || '', raw).to.include('text/event-stream'); });
var frames = raw.split(/\n\n/).map(function (f) { var m = /^data: (\{.*\})$/m.exec(f); return m ? JSON.parse(m[1]) : null; }).filter(Boolean);

pm.test('two audio deltas, then speech.audio.done as the final frame', function () { pm.expect(frames.map(function (f) { return f.type; }), raw).to.eql(['speech.audio.delta', 'speech.audio.delta', 'speech.audio.done']); });

pm.test('usage is the vendor\'s: output_tokens without the thought tokens, total_tokens with them', function () { pm.expect(done.usage, raw).to.be.an('object'); pm.expect(done.usage.input_tokens, raw).to.equal(7); pm.expect(done.usage.output_tokens, raw).to.equal(50); pm.expect(done.usage.total_tokens, raw).to.equal(69); });

pm.test('usage.output_token_details carries candidatesTokensDetails and thoughtsTokenCount', function () { pm.expect(done.usage.output_token_details, raw).to.eql({ audio_tokens: 50, reasoning_tokens: 12 }); pm.expect(done.usage.input_token_details, raw).to.eql({ text_tokens: 7 }); });

geminiCalls(function (calls) { pm.test('exactly one upstream call', function () { pm.expect(calls, JSON.stringify(calls.map(function (c) { return c.path; }))).to.have.length(1); pm.expect(calls[0].path, calls[0].path).to.equal('/pp/gemini/models/pp-tts-ok:streamGenerateContent'); }); });

geminiCalls(function (calls) { pm.test('the bound is sent as generationConfig.maxOutputTokens, not under its unified name', function () { var sent = JSON.parse(calls[0].body); pm.expect(sent.generationConfig.maxOutputTokens, calls[0].body).to.equal(1024); pm.expect(sent.generationConfig.responseModalities, calls[0].body).to.eql(['AUDIO']); pm.expect(calls[0].body, calls[0].body).to.match(/voiceName.{1,5}Kore/); pm.expect(sent.max_output_tokens, calls[0].body).to.equal(undefined); }); });

item.name: 335.16 gemini /genai/v1beta/models/pp-tts-ok:streamGenerateContent the native stream sends the bare PCM and ends on finishReason STOP with the output token details, from one upstream call (gemini speech contract)

exec: pm.test('gemini speech contract setup: the fixture was reset', function () {
// geminiCalls: the requests that reached the fixture's Gemini upstream, bytes as they arrived.

function geminiCalls(cb) { pm.sendRequest({ url: FX + '/__wire', method: 'GET' }, function (err, res) { pm.test('the fixture answered /__wire', function () { pm.expect(err, String(err)).to.equal(null); pm.expect(res.code).to.equal(200); }); cb(res.json().data[0].calls.filter(function (c) { return c.path.indexOf('/pp/gemini/models/') === 0; })); }); }

pm.test('the client gets 200 with an SSE stream', function () { pm.expect(pm.response.code, raw).to.equal(200); pm.expect(pm.response.headers.get('content-type') || '', raw).to.include('text/event-stream'); });
var frames = raw.split(/\n\n/).map(function (f) { var m = /^data: (\{.*\})$/m.exec(f); return m ? JSON.parse(m[1]) : null; }).filter(Boolean);

pm.test('the audio chunks are the bare PCM Gemini sent', function () { var blob = frames[0].candidates[0].content.parts[0].inlineData; pm.expect(blob.data, raw).to.equal('AAECAwQF'); pm.expect(blob.mimeType, raw).to.equal('audio/L16;codec=pcm;rate=24000'); });

pm.test('the final frame carries finishReason STOP and every usage detail', function () { var last = frames[frames.length - 1] || {}; pm.expect(last.candidates && last.candidates[0].finishReason, raw).to.equal('STOP'); var u = last.usageMetadata; pm.expect(u, raw).to.be.an('object'); pm.expect(u.candidatesTokenCount, raw).to.equal(50); pm.expect(u.thoughtsTokenCount, raw).to.equal(12); pm.expect(u.candidatesTokensDetails, raw).to.eql([{ modality: 'AUDIO', tokenCount: 50 }]); });

geminiCalls(function (calls) { pm.test('exactly one upstream call', function () { pm.expect(calls, JSON.stringify(calls.map(function (c) { return c.path; }))).to.have.length(1); pm.expect(calls[0].path, calls[0].path).to.equal('/pp/gemini/models/pp-tts-ok:streamGenerateContent'); }); });

geminiCalls(function (calls) { pm.test('generationConfig.maxOutputTokens reached Gemini unchanged', function () { var sent = JSON.parse(calls[0].body); pm.expect(sent.generationConfig.maxOutputTokens, calls[0].body).to.equal(2048); }); });
